findings.claim: A fixed two-scale curvature stencil reconstructs measured Bz map pixels more accurately than the matched affine control on the reserved specimen.
findings.equation: B_hat = [4(Hx+Hy) - (Ox+Oy)]/6; inner means at4pixel offsets, outer means at8pixel offsets.
findings.evidence: CSL/129DOA: block-balanced MAE2.084e-6 source-native units versus affine2.283e-6 and local mean2.468e-6;5605 target pixels in36 spatial blocks.
findings.known_prior_art: This is a standard fourth-order interpolation stencil. It is not a new magnetostatic or thermal law.
findings.falsification: One reserved specimen and same-map neighboring calibration; native SI conversion remains unresolved.
findings.scope: Retrospective metrology, source-native measured magnetic-map product.

findings.claim: The tested imaging-axis anisotropy and additional spatial smoothing do not improve the development-selected reconstruction.
findings.equation: Directional convex weighting, contrast-adaptive weighting, positive outer-ring smoothing and range-limited curvature candidates are preserved.
findings.evidence: None improves the selected fixed stencil on the primary development metric; positive smoothing collapses to zero added smoothing.
findings.known_prior_art: Horizontal-plane interpolation does not enforce the full three-dimensional magnetic field equations.
findings.falsification: These narrow numerical failures do not refute localized magnetic heterogeneity or the source thermal analysis.
findings.scope: Only fixed sparse target geometry in the two supplied fields of view.

findings.claim: These reconstructions independently validate source temperatures, frictional energy or a new earthquake heating law.
findings.evidence: The available temperature and MCMC outputs are author-derived, and the task has no independent temperature endpoint.
findings.known_prior_art: The source publication already estimates thermal histories from calibrated demagnetization and diffusion models.
findings.falsification: Neither temperature inversion nor independent thermal validation is performed here.
findings.scope: No thermal-law admission; measurement-to-SI mapping needs additional authoritative clarification.

scientific_adjudication: Agent-assisted analysis; not independent experimental replication or human expert adjudication.
